def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); ss=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or (a,b) in seen or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.add((a,b))
                    stack+= [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                ss.append((col,cells))
    def bbox(cells):
        i0=min(i for i,j in cells); j0=min(j for i,j in cells)
        return i0,j0,max(i for i,j in cells)-i0+1,max(j for i,j in cells)-j0+1
    def isring(cells):
        i0,j0,h,w=bbox(cells)
        ring={(i,j) for i in range(i0,i0+h) for j in range(j0,j0+w) if i in(i0,i0+h-1) or j in(j0,j0+w-1)}
        return cells==ring
    def fall(group,up):
        res=[[0]*W for _ in g]
        for col,cells in group:
            i0,j0,h,w=bbox(cells)
            norm=sorted((i-i0,j-j0) for i,j in cells)
            r=i0
            while True:
                nr=r-1 if up else r+1
                if nr<0 or nr+h>H: break
                if any(res[nr+a][j0+b] for a,b in norm): break
                r=nr
            for a,b in norm: res[r+a][j0+b]=col
        return res
    rings=sorted([s for s in ss if isring(s[1])],key=lambda s:bbox(s[1])[0])
    ts=sorted([s for s in ss if not isring(s[1])],key=lambda s:-bbox(s[1])[0])
    A=fall(rings,True); B=fall(ts,False)
    return [[B[i][j] or A[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
